hero.title: into actions your team can track.
hero.sub: Use the request context to interpret conversations, extract owners and dates, preserve source evidence, and send uncertain details to a human for review.

principles.confirmText: Every write, merge and closure is traceable

problem.label: From conversation to execution
problem.title: An agreement should not disappear under the next message.
problem.body: Cross-team work often starts with a sentence in chat. Owners, dates and next steps remain scattered across the thread. FlowDesk turns those conversations into actions that teams can review, assign and follow through.

workflow.label: End-to-end workflow
workflow.title: Move from a request to an executable action
workflow.intakeText: Describe the problem, then paste the original conversation.
workflow.reviewText: Check owners, dates, evidence and open questions.
workflow.listText: Filter by business line, owner, due date and status.
workflow.detailText: Review the request, source messages, confirmations and history.

features.label: Capabilities
features.title: AI interprets. People make the final call.
features.intro: The system turns unstructured conversations into action drafts while keeping enough context for reviewers to understand every result.
features.contextText: Understand the outcome first, then identify commitments and next steps in the conversation.
features.extractText: Extract a title, owner, supporting team, due date, priority and source.
features.evidenceText: Trace every field to its sentence. Leave unsupported fields empty.
features.matchText: Match shorthand names to the directory and present candidates when a name is ambiguous.
features.rulesText: Use deterministic rules for normalized dates and overdue status instead of treating guesses as facts.
features.trackText: Record every write, merge, closure and undo operation.

trust.label: Explainable AI collaboration
trust.title: The system drafts the work. It does not decide for the team.
trust.body: When an owner is missing, a date is only a range, or a shorthand name matches several people, FlowDesk keeps the question in review. Tracking starts only after a coordinator confirms it.

cta.title: Start with a real conversation.
cta.text: Add the request context and team chat to see FlowDesk create the first action draft.
